items.title: 4.7.2 Product ki zyada se zyada miqdar aur bache hue excess reagent ki miqdar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.7.2, printed pages 87-89.

blocks.title: Excess reagent
blocks.text: Woh reactants jo reaction ki stoichiometry ki zaroorat se zyada miqdar mein maujood hon aur reaction ke aakhir mein ghair-react shuda bach jayein, excess reagents (excess ya non-limiting reactants) hain.

2H2(g) + O2(g) se 2H2O(l) par ghaur karein. Jab hydrogen ke 2 moles (4 g) oxygen ke 2 moles (64 g) se react karein to sirf pani ke 2 moles (36 g) bante hain, kyunke hydrogen ke 2 moles ko oxygen ka sirf 1 mole (32 g) chahiye; hydrogen limiting reactant hai aur oxygen ka 1 mole bach jata hai. Jab O2 ka 1 mole aur H2 ka 1 mole milaye jayein to sari hydrogen react karti hai aur oxygen bach jati hai, kyunke H2 ke 1 mole ko O2 ka sirf aadha mole chahiye; baqi aadha mole excess hai.
Sample Problem 4.19: 30 g CH4 aur 50 g O2

Methane CH4 + 2O2 se CO2 + 2H2O ke taur par jalti hai. Qadam 1, balanced muadla likhein. Qadam 2, har reactant ke moles: CH4 = 30 / 16 = 1.875 mol; O2 = 50 / 32 = 1.563 mol. Qadam 3, har ek se product: 1 mol CH4 se 1 mol CO2, to 1.875 mol CO2; 2 mol O2 se 1 mol CO2, to 1.563 x 0.5 = 0.7815 mol CO2. Oxygen kam deti hai, to O2 limiting reactant hai. Qadam 4, product ka mass: 0.7815 x 44 = 34.39 g CO2. Qadam 5, limiting reactant tai karta hai ke excess reactant kitna istemal hota hai: 2 mol O2 1 mol CH4 se react karte hain, to 1.563 mol O2 1.563 x 1/2 = 0.7815 mol CH4 istemal karte hain. Qadam 6, bacha hua excess = liya hua - istemal shuda = 1.875 - 0.7815 = 1.0935 mol CH4, jo 1.0935 x 16.0 = 17.5 g ghair-react shuda methane hai.

blocks.alt: Do jore patti-graph (bars). Oopar 'Maujood moles': CH4 1.875 mol (lambi neeli patti), O2 1.563 mol (surkh patti). Neeche 'Har ek se kitna CO2 ban sakta hai': CH4 se 1.875 mol, O2 se sirf 0.7815 mol (chhoti surkh patti). Surkh khaane mein 'Limiting reactant: O2'. Neeche nateeje: CO2 bani 0.7815 x 44 = 34.39 g; CH4 bachi 1.0935 x 16 = 17.5 g (excess).
blocks.caption: Sample Problem 4.19: limiting reactant O2, 34.39 g CO2 aur 17.5 g CH4 baqi (hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).
blocks.long_description: Tees gram methane 1.875 mol hai aur pachas gram oxygen 1.563 mol. Methane 1.875 mol CO2 bana sakti hai magar oxygen sirf 0.7815 mol, to oxygen mehdood karti hai aur 34.39 g CO2 zyada se zyada ban sakta hai. Oxygen 0.7815 mol methane istemal karti hai, 1.0935 mol, 17.5 g, ghair-react shuda chhor kar. Hydrogen misal mein 2 mol H2 2 mol O2 ke saath sirf 36 g pani dete hain aur 1 mol oxygen chhorte hain. Percentage yield asal product ka is nazriyati zyada se zyada se muqabla karti hai.

blocks.prompt: 34.0 g ammonia 80.0 g oxygen se 4NH3 + 5O2 = 4NO + 6H2O ke mutabiq react karti hai. Limiting reactant, NO ka zyada se zyada mass, aur bacha hua excess reactant nikalein (H = 1.0, N = 14.0, O = 16.0).
blocks.explanation: NH3: 34.0 / 17.0 = 2.0 mol; O2: 80.0 / 32.0 = 2.5 mol. NH3 se NO: 2.0 mol (4 : 4); O2 se NO: 2.5 x 4/5 = 2.0 mol. Dono barabar dete hain, to mixture theek tanasub mein hai aur koi excess nahi; zyada se zyada NO 2.0 mol x 30.0 g/mol = 60.0 g hai aur koi reactant nahi bachta.

items: Excess reagent: ghair-react shuda bacha reactant. Limiting reactant se product zyada se zyada hai; istemal shuda excess = limiting moles x tanasub; bacha excess = liya hua - istemal shuda.
30 g CH4 + 50 g O2: O2 mehdood karti hai (0.7815 mol CO2, 34.39 g); 0.7815 mol CH4 istemal, 1.0935 mol = 17.5 g bacha.
